<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Cabinet approves major parliamentary expansion:</strong> The Union Cabinet has cleared a bill to increase Lok Sabha seats by 50%—potentially raising the total to 815—while linking the reform to a women&#x27;s reservation quota and freezing state seat shares until 2051.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipwFBVV95cUxPWHBWdFZ2T0g5V1NmNjVkNmNMU0RpWldhRkJFOVBfMDJnYVFTdmtZRUtKb2lseFNZYW9JZ1JXZ0poNG5LY3pBemtjVmRRS0ZkQ0lYa0QwbWJMMGxpY0hET2RHbFVnTFItd1FQUGdfZ2UzazN0MGp4WmZHM0ZSUGJia2sxeFU1bmQ3UWRlLTNTalJYM1hnRC1CYkdJcXR4SDhhR0psWWt1SQ?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I6</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi-?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I7</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I8</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I9</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I10</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I11</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I24</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I25</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Opposition prepares for special session:</strong> Congress, NCP(SP), and other opposition parties have issued whips to their MPs and scheduled unity meetings ahead of the special Parliament session beginning November 30, though internal divisions persist within the INDIA bloc.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I5</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I19</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I31</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I32</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I33</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Political pushback against delimitation:</strong> Opposition leaders, including Akhilesh Yadav, have criticized the proposed delimitation bill, while the government seeks to secure the necessary support to pass these constitutional amendments.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi_?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I15</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivAFBVV95cUxOd0FjdXRnQ0dEZUo5dGZlbHhyQ0Faa2hxZ0hvdHJjU194U195aHJjbnF4NVFKNERWVUlGUi1TQlJIN3BQZTdkd2ctUEZlTjJjejJyYlkyeWxZdmg5WFptbFRTX1ZVSnByVmFGX1dSV2lnRWRIOTFCWDl3eEVLOHpGZEQwc3kyM1RNLXpjTmtPQjlJYWt2dnhXS2dULTdXWElXSzk1Vm9hTmRtc2VVTEJ5YW15SDUwbzFGcFFKLQ?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I17</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I18</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I22</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I30</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Strategic maneuvering for legislative support:</strong> As the government pushes for the delimitation and women&#x27;s reservation bills, the NDA is working to secure a two-thirds majority, with some regional parties like the YSRCP signaling conditional support.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiwgFBVV95cUxPckZyOTNPXzBQemUyaFVZb2lmQnFhd1NHdUlmLXM4N1lvODhOaENYNDVmQ1RHbkpxLVRHTkdGd29JSmtpZWJIWEdfc3hBYmNVajhoMnJqMXRsUEZqdVRJWm52V05fdjBiMWw1VWhtNHRrdE5JSDdDczFrVkVhZzNqMm9XdENiZzdpT0h2ak01QTVqVEkybE5JVWpkcHFWTVZWNHUxdm1Hc1MwN0JmTTlLYURxdHdtZ3VXYk9BSkwyd29KQQ?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W10</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W12</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Opposition outreach efforts:</strong> Congress President Mallikarjun Kharge is actively engaging with non-NDA parties, including the DMK, AAP, and BJD, to build a unified front against the government&#x27;s legislative agenda.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W6</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W7</a></span></li>
</ul>
